provider: IHK Berlin (Industrie- und Handelskammer zu Berlin)

limitations: IHK records are businesses registered with IHK Berlin (Handelsregister entries and Kleingewerbetreibende). Craft businesses registered only with the Handwerkskammer, freelancers and public bodies are absent.
OSM places and IHK businesses are separate inventories. Report source-specific counts; never add them as unique businesses.
A registration is not proof of an open venue: a registered address may be an office or home address, and branch locations may be missing.
employees_min/employees_max are the inclusive bounds of the supplied size class, not headcounts. '0 Beschäftigte' means no reported employees; 'unbekannt' and missing classes have null bounds.
business_age_label is the supplied business age at the edition date, kept as text.
planungsraum_id is supplied by IHK and reported against the pinned LOR snapshot; it is never reassigned from coordinates.
